items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and dull.
A mild-strength retinol night serum is a sensible starting point to help smooth the look of fine lines and improve the look of firmness.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to boost comfort and plumpness, since your scan shows low surface moisture.
A daily mineral SPF 50 protects skin from sun and is essential alongside a retinol.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, moisturize, then apply sunscreen; evenings: cleanse, apply a pea-sized amount of retinol 2 nights a week and build up slowly as comfortable, then moisturize. If skin feels sore, stinging or very dry, pause the retinol, and if you have any concerns about your skin, a dermatologist is the best person to ask.
